items.name: 刘备
items.definition: Liu Bei. Kind adult male, bright brown rounded eyes, soft rounded-square jaw, calm smile, black swept hair with LOW compact tied bun. Only a fine small moustache and tiny separated chin goatee, jaw still visible. Simple ivory cross-collar tunic with jade-green short open coat, thin clean gold border, brown waist belt, dark blue-green trousers, cream/brown low ankle boots. Robe hem near knees rather than hiding all legs. Small plain shoulder guards, NO elaborate armor. Warm friendly gentleman-warrior, slim-balanced width.
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one FOUR-VIEW definition sheet of ONE single consistent character design, not alternative costumes. Input image1 is the actual game's male protagonist and is the PRIMARY mandatory style and compact anatomy reference. Input image2 is the game's approved protagonist/D1 lineup, secondary confirmation of the same game aesthetic. This is a COSTUME/IDENTITY VARIANT in that existing game, not a new historical illustration aesthetic.
Match the protagonist's bright soft high-quality Japanese-anime 3D game render: large rounded expressive eyes, small simple nose/mouth, soft rounded face contours, sculpted clean hair clumps, clear saturated color areas, clean fabric and smooth materials. Rounded appealing shapes, subtle neutral diffuse shading; no gritty medieval realism, no ink-heavy comic outlines, no tiny ornate patterns, no dark bronze filigree or photoreal pores. Character remains recognizable as the named classical adult male through restrained face and costume cues.
BODY CONTRACT: 3.30 head units from BASE scalp crown to soles, excluding topknot/crown/headwrap decorations and beard. One H is anatomical crown-to-chin, NOT just visible forehead-to-chin. Large cranium matching source hero. Compact torso and limbs; SAME height and broad proportion rhythm as source hero. Neck/torso/pelvis from chin to crotch about1H, crotch to soles1.3H. Short compact limbs, neat narrower calves, modest rounded hands and practical boots. Differences in strength via shoulder/waist width only, never stretching height. All four views identical model, scale, age, face, clothing, limb lengths.
LAYOUT: wide1536x1024 canvas with FOUR whole-body figures evenly spaced in one row: FRONT, exact RIGHT facing image-right, BACK, genuine FRONT45 rotated45degrees with head chest hips and feet together. Camera orthographic-like at same height. Front45 shows both eyes with farther eye smaller, clear nose projecting towards image-right, visible near side and foreshortened torso. Gentle neutral A-pose, both hands and all feet visible, generous10% margin, soles aligned. Pure white background. Exactly FOUR figures, NO extra portraits, accessory diagram, extra character, labels, writing, ruler, grid, shadow under feet or landscape. Weapons omitted from sheet to keep body unobstructed.

Liu Bei. Kind adult male, bright brown rounded eyes, soft rounded-square jaw, calm smile, black swept hair with LOW compact tied bun. Only a fine small moustache and tiny separated chin goatee, jaw still visible. Simple ivory cross-collar tunic with jade-green short open coat, thin clean gold border, brown waist belt, dark blue-green trousers, cream/brown low ankle boots. items.correction: Edit the supplied Liu Bei four-view sheet. Keep exactly the same bright soft 3D anime game style, jade/cream costume, single fixed character design and all four views. Two precise corrections only: (1) enlarge the entire head including cranium and hair by about8 percent in ALL four views while keeping the same body, so base hair/skull crown to jaw length is one third-point-three of crown-to-foot height, excluding the tied bun and goatee; slightly shorten legs only if needed. Preserve clear chin above goatee. (2) the fourth figure must be a TRUE FRONT-RIGHT45degree rotation: nose axis towards image-right, near ear prominent, far half face narrower, far eye partially foreshortened, chest depth and near side visible, pelvis AND both feet rotated with body. It must be midway between first front and second profile, NOT almost frontal. Front and right profile and back stay canonical. Give enough white margins no hand clipped. No writing, labels, ruler or props.

items.name: 关羽
items.definition: Guan Yu. Adult male general with warm muted reddish complexion (intentional character cue), big calm rounded amber eyes, level bold eyebrows, full rounded cranium. Deep green low close-fitting headcloth no towering knot. Iconic long black smooth tapered beard (three clean sculpted clumps, not wiry) begins UNDER visible jawline. Deep jade green knee-length robe over cream cross-collar inner, simple muted gold chest guard with broad clean panels, brown belt, dark trousers, neat brown boots. Moderately broad shoulders, dignified expression; no terrifying scowl or ultra-muscular limbs. Bright green/gold, NOT blackened medieval armor.

items.name: 张飞
items.definition: Zhang Fei. Adult stocky strong male, lively big rounded darkbrown eyes, broad friendly rounded-square face, thick eyebrows gently curved rather than angry V, wide determined grin. Short black tousled sculpted hair with small red tie, short rounded black beard below clearly legible chin. Warm medium skin, red jacket with dark charcoal simple armor panels and narrow gold trim, cream cross collar, brown belt, navy compact trousers, brown ankleboots. Stronger shoulder/torso width and forearms, SAME head/height rhythm as hero, NOT thick stump-like legs. Clean cheerful gamehero quality, no tiny scales or dragon filigree.

items.name: 孙悟空
items.definition: Sun Wukong. Adult anthropomorphic monkey hero with lively big rounded gold-brown eyes, warm golden fur, cream smooth monkeyface heart-shaped patch, compact rounded cranium and small rounded monkeyears. Swept golden sculpted hair clumps with low gold circlet, friendly confident closed-mouth smile. Scarlet short jacket with simple gold trim and creaminner, small clean gold chest panel, tigerstripe small waistcloth limited to waist, navy compact trousers, cream legwraps, brown/gold low boots. Slender agile width, SAME3.3 head anatomy as source. One slim curved tail visible in side/back45 attached anatomically to lower back; not oversized. No staff in hand, no dragon filigree, no battle glare.
